styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent bold pop color-block summer-footwear ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of #FFFFFF, saturated sky #2FB6EF and lemon #F4D514 as base fields with #1A1A1A as the single accent and the only ink color; cool bright tone at 5800K; modern geometric sans-serif for both Chinese and Latin copy, one solid #1A1A1A tag header with a short arrow plus one headline per screen, dashed hairline rules, no serif or handwritten faces; background system of flat matte painted color-block fields with a hairline #FFFFFF taped line, one #FFFFFF painted wire-grid panel and gingham cards, never random scenery and never printed texture; lighting system of bright high-key studio light from the upper left with crisp soft-edged contact shadows and one single light direction in every screen; layout system of solid #1A1A1A tag headers with a short arrow, dashed rules, numbered circular markers, dashed circular badges and one callout leader style; icon system of thin single-weight line pictograms only, no 3D, no gradients, no shadows on icons; product presentation rules: true proportions, stable slight 3/4 front, clean 90-degree side, high 45-degree or 90-degree overhead geometry, identical scale and centering across all screens, vent-hole spacing and eyelet-row scale never changing, every sole grounded with a visible contact shadow; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no scale drift between screens.

provenance.notes: 14 片详情页切片逐片识图。源夹名「鞋」为粗粒度提示，与最终 L1 鞋靴 不冲突；按图判定主体为女款低帮系带休闲鞋（尺码屏以女鞋称之、膝下女装搭配出镜），故 L2 取 女鞋 而非 运动鞋 或 凉拖鞋。与库内 女款纯白平底系带板鞋 及 女款尖头蝴蝶结浅口单鞋 做了双重差异化：鞋型取冲孔镂空薄底系带休闲鞋，视觉体系由高饱和 #2FB6EF 与 #F4D514 撞色几何棚拍 + #1A1A1A 标签条与虚线引线构成，而非低饱和粉彩台面。已剥离：鞋身侧面印刷字母与鞋底压印字样、商品名称与货号、颜色名、面/内里/底材质与结构表述、尺码与脚长对照表全部数值、允许误差数值、原文卖点句式与英文装饰字、模特面部与身份（仅保留膝下与单手）。所有文案与数值一律改为 {selling_point_*} / {callout_*} 占位，材质与工艺表述改为可见结构描述并附禁止虚构的 negative，由下游按买家真实商品资料回填。本套件承接详情页带内嵌文案的原生形式，因此保留 textZone；若用于主图平台需置空。未虚构任何检测、认证、评分、销量、折扣或功效声明。
